name: Jardin botanique de Limbé
description: Created in 1892; official MINTOUL profile describes about 1,000 plant species, 500 trees and 48 hectares; includes Jungle Village and visitor trails.

name: Mont Cameroun
description: Volcanic mountain near the Atlantic coast; MINTOUL profile describes an elevation of about 4,100 m and the annual Course de l'Espoir.

name: Palais de Justice de Douala
description: Historic building in the first arrondissement of Douala, with German and French colonial-era history and architectural interest.

name: Chutes de la Lobé
description: UNESCO Tentative List cultural landscape; MINTOUL beach-tourism page identifies the Lobé waterfall as flowing directly into the sea at Kribi.

name: Parc national de Korup
description: MINTOUL identifies Korup National Park as an ecotourism site with very old plant species.

name: Réserve du Dja
description: MINTOUL identifies the Dja Reserve as UNESCO World Heritage.

name: Mayo Rey fossil sites
description: MINTOUL identifies fossilized dinosaur footprints in the Mayo Rey area.

name: Mont Fébé
description: Listed by MINTOUL as a tourist site in its sports-tourism content.

name: Palais des Congrès de Yaoundé
description: MINTOUL identifies Yaoundé as a business and congress tourism destination with international-standard infrastructure including the Palais des Congrès.

name: Côte et plages de Kribi
description: MINTOUL identifies Kribi as one of Cameroon's coastal resort cities.

name: Côte et plages de Limbe
description: MINTOUL identifies Limbe as one of Cameroon's coastal resort cities.

name: Golf de Yaoundé
description: MINTOUL lists golf in Yaoundé as a tourism-related sport.

name: Golf de Tiko
description: MINTOUL lists golf in Tiko as a tourism-related sport.

name: Pêche au gros au large des côtes
description: MINTOUL identifies deep-sea fishing as a tourism-related activity.
